subject: geography
title: Building Greener Cities
welcome_lead: How can your own town be greener? Discover smart ideas from public transport to smart grids.
meta_desc: KS3 Geography adventure on green city strategies, transport, recycling and smart grids.
final_note: Brilliant! You can now suggest ideas for greener cities.

walkthroughs.body_html: Cities can cut emissions by promoting buses, trams, cycling and walking. London's congestion charge and Paris's bike-sharing schemes are good examples.
Smart grids use sensors to match electricity use with renewable supply. Combined with recycling and better insulation, cities slash waste.
Parks, green roofs and urban farms cool cities, boost biodiversity and improve mental health. Singapore is a 'garden city' role model!

mcqs.q: What is the difference between constructive and destructive waves?
options: Big waves are destructive and small waves are constructive.
Biotic and abiotic both refer to types of soil.
Constructive waves have strong swash and weak backwash, building beaches; destructive waves have weak swash and strong backwash, dragging sediment offshore and eroding cliffs.
Constructive waves build sandcastles and destructive waves wash them away.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between biotic and abiotic components of an ecosystem?
options: Biotic and abiotic both refer to types of soil.
Constructive waves build sandcastles and destructive waves wash them away.
Biotic components are all living organisms (plants, animals, microbes); abiotic components are non-living factors (climate, soil, water, light, rock).
Biotic means animals and abiotic means plants.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between a megacity and a world city?
options: Megacities and world cities are the same thing.
A megacity is defined by population (over 10 million); a world city is defined by global economic and cultural influence (e.g. New York, London) — so a city can be one without the other.
Constructive waves build sandcastles and destructive waves wash them away.
A megacity has over 1 million people and a world city has over 5 million.
